messages:
Elaine K.: Heads-up — cutoff is in ~3 hours. I have a small dependency bump (PR #6218) that fixes a flaky test affecting canaries. Can we get an exception or do a cherrypick?
Samir: @Elaine K. what's changed in the bump? semver patch? any runtime risk?
Elaine K.: It's a patch: bump yarn lock for a test helper lib. No behavioral changes, just fixes a test race. CI green locally.
Jordan (releases): We should follow the freeze-exception flow — call out impact, rollback plan, and approvals. If it's truly no-risk we can do a last-minute merge but need 2 LGTMs + release lead signoff. @Maria or @Alex can one of you eyeball?
Maria: I can take a quick look now. If it's only lockfile and tests, :+1: from me after check.
Alex: I'll review too. If both OK, Jordan — will you authorize moving it through?
Jordan (releases): Yep, if both LGTMs and regression checklist passes I can sign off. Also pinging @Priya for any canary monitoring to watch post-merge.
Priya: I'll add a short smoke test to the canary pipeline and watch error rates for the next 2 hours.
Samir: Two quick asks: 1) make sure changelog entry is not required for this; 2) include a rollback snippet in the PR description in case we need to revert fast.
Elaine K.: Will do both. Adding rollback command to PR: 
```
# to revert merge commit on main
git revert -m 1 <merge-commit-sha>
git push origin main
```
Samir: Nice. Also please note which release branch to cherrypick to if main is frozen.
Elaine K.: Cherrypick target: release/v1.8.0 — will create PR if we can't merge to main.
deploy-bot: :information_source: Release freeze will start at 2026-10-06 18:00 UTC. Exceptions must be approved before freeze.
Jordan (releases): Ok timeline: merge allowed until freeze if approved. If not approved, prepare cherrypick to release branch and tag for next patch.
Alex: Quick review done — nothing risky. LGTM from me.
Maria: LGTM from me too.
Jordan (releases): I approve the exception. Elaine — merge once CI passes and then update this thread with merge commit sha. I'll monitor rollout. :thumbsup:
Elaine K.: Thanks everyone — merging now. Merge commit: d4f8a2b. Cherrypick PR opened: #6220 -> release/v1.8.0 (in case).
Priya: Canary smoke started. No anomalies in first 15m. Will update if anything pops.
Samir: Great. Reminder for changelog team: no user-facing change for this one, skip entry.
Elaine K.: Closing the loop — everything merged and monitored. Thanks all! :tada:
